source_text.body:
Give an agent a rack-mounted phone to operate over ADB
The author set up a rack-mounted Fairphone 6 so their agent can use it through ADB.
·
Oct 24, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The author mounted a Fairphone 6 in a rack and set it up so their agent can operate it over ADB. The post is a single short line with a photo. It doesn't describe the agent, the tasks, or any human oversight.
How it went
The post gives no results, numbers, or limitations. It only shows that the setup exists.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I have an Android phone connected to this computer over ADB (device serial: [serial]). Check that adb sees it, then write a small script that can take a screenshot, tap at coordinates, type text, and open the app [app name]. Test it by opening [app name] and reading me what's on screen, then stop and tell me what commands you set up.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/samantha.wiki/post/3myngjlbuyc26
